name: The Sommerdahl Murders
description: A love triangle between Dan Sommerdahl, his wife Marianne Sommerdahl and their best friend Flemming Torp occurs as they try to solves killings in Helsingør.

videos.title: Till death do us part (1)
videos.overview: Police investigators Dan and Marianne Sommerdahl's 25th wedding anniversary is interrupted when a Slavic woman is found dead. The woman has given birth recently, and now every minute counts in the mission of finding the baby.

videos.title: Till death do us part (2)
videos.overview: Dan and Flemming find out that a local woman had adopted the Slavic woman's baby and pretended to her husband that it was their own. But when the biological mother demanded her baby back, things got completely out of control.

videos.title: First Contact (1)
videos.overview: When a mother is found dead on the local food market, Dan and Flemming find out that the woman, who is a lottery winner, has been a victim of a marriage swindler. They manage to capture the swindler's accomplice and male lover.

videos.title: First Contact (2)
videos.overview: Dan and Flemming create a false identity for Marianne, who will pretend to be another lottery winner in order to get the marriage swindler out from hiding and hopefully caught. But the man has an alibi. Who is really the killer?

videos.title: The Law of Retribution (1)
videos.overview: A businessman is found dead on the same day his company's accountant is reported missing. In the presumption that the accountant is the killer, the pursuit to find him begins. But it turns out the accountant is actually kidnapped.

videos.title: The Law of Retribution (2)
videos.overview: Dan and Flemming find out that the relationship between the playboy entrepreneur and his partner in the company was on the rocks. Following this discovery, the duo considers him a suspect in the killing and kidnapping case.

videos.title: Fatal Score (1)
videos.overview: The owner of Elsinore football club finds the club's representative dead two days before the final annual game. Not only is that shocking, it's also a disaster for the owner who struggles with the club’s poor financial situation.

videos.title: Fatal Score (2)
videos.overview: After the suspected football player is released, he visits the rival team's star player at the hospital. It is clear that the two men have a secret. It turns out that the deceased has been blackmailing them.

videos.title: Lost Dream (1)
videos.overview: Dan Sommerdaul is determined to do anything it takes to convince his wife Marianne to come back to him. But before he gets to that, he must uncover the perpetrator behind the murder of a world-famous guitarist.

videos.title: Love Endures All Things (Almost) (1)
videos.overview: A piece of information from an unexpected source complicates the murder case even more, as it leads Dan and his team to several women in the town who had been in unresolved romantic relationships with the deceased rock star.

videos.title: I Hate That I Love You (1)
videos.overview: When a boarding school teacher is found dead only days before an important school play, it is discovered that he was romantically involved with a police officer. Is it possible that the murderer is hiding in the police station?

videos.title: I Hate That I Love You (2)
The Ends Justify the Means (1)
videos.overview: When another employee from the boarding school is found murdered, Dan directs his suspicions at the school staff. But the evidence he finds there helps him realize that he had been looking for the perpetrator in the wrong place.

videos.title: Repressed Emotions (1)
videos.overview: The team is having a hard time finding conclusive evidence, when the father of a family is found dead. Dan still has no idea of the relationship between Flemming and Marianne.

videos.title: Repressed Emotions (2)
videos.overview: The secrets come pouring out, while the deceased's family is in great danger. Will Dan and Flemming connect all the evidence before it's too late?

videos.title: The Cannes of the North (1)
videos.overview: Dan and Flemming are called to a case, where a local contractor has been found dead. They are in for quite a shock, when they find out who is involved.

videos.title: The Cannes of the North (2)
videos.overview: New evidence shows up in the case, which sends Dan on his most challenging task so far. Will they manage to solve the case before all the evidence disappears?

videos.title: For Love of God and Country (1)
videos.overview: Dan and Benjamin investigates the murder of a nun at a local closter. Did everyone agree with the victim's choice of living in a closter and who is responsible for the crime comitted?

videos.title: For Love of God and Country (2)
videos.overview: The team must respond to a call-out to the memorial service for the fallen soldiers, since a group of demonstrators make their presence. Although, not everyone can handle the pressure.

videos.title: Fair Play (1)
videos.overview: The partners Dan and Flemming get called out to solve a case where a woman is found dead in her car, while her most precious trophy dog is nowhere to be seen.

videos.title: Fair Play (2)
videos.overview: New evidence turns up and the team suddenly become busy. Will they finally catch the killer? In the meantime Laura and Benjamin have a big decision to make.

videos.title: Prize and Penalty (1)
videos.overview: After her own birthday party a local wine entrepreneur is found dead in her own wine cellar. During the interrogation of the party's guests the first mysterious clue turns up.

videos.title: Prize and Penalty (2)
videos.overview: Dan and Flemming receive help from an unexpected side. In the meantime Benjamin and the new officer, Nadia, go undercover and get close to the vineyard's secrets.

videos.title: Something Smells Fishy (1)
videos.overview: The day after an illegal party a school pupil is found dead. The victim was dealing MDMA, but is this a drugs-related murder? Or was the killing committed by an other youth?

videos.title: Something Smells Fishy (2)
videos.overview: The police go all in to try and find the youth's secrets. Mean while Dans relationship with Josefine is blooming, while she is extremely interested in Dan's current case.

videos.title: Back on the Horse (1)
videos.overview: Shortly before the derby of the year a murder is committed by the racecourse. Nobody has seen anything of the killer or the favourite to win the race, who at the same time has disappeared from their stable

videos.title: Back on the Horse (2)
videos.overview: Despite her fall the jockey Kate returns to the race. At the same time Dan has a big question for Josefine, but Flemming and Marianne are about to destroy his plans.

videos.title: The Good Human (1)
videos.overview: During a religious Summer camp a member is found dead. An old case haunts the ongoing investigation, but Dan has difficulty putting the pieces together.

videos.title: The Good Human (2)
videos.overview: While the pieces are starting to fall into place in the police's investigation, Dan is slowly breaking down. Is Josefine not at all the person he thought she was?

videos.title: The Next Generation (1)
videos.overview: The funfair has come to Helsingør and soon joy, and laughter are replaced by screams. A high-ranking employee has been shot during his shift at the shooting booth, but as it happens in the middle of a turbulent shift change, doubt as to whether the killer got the right man quickly arises. Josefine is still accused of Otto's drug smuggling, but Dan does everything in his power to get her released.

videos.title: The Next Generation (2)
videos.overview: The funfair is in many ways running on the edge of the law, so unfortunately, not everyone is equally willing to cooperate with Dan and Flemming. Marianne has found a foreign hair on the deceased, which with some effort may lead them to the killer. But what the police do not yet know is that a stalker is out there following the widow, Ene.

videos.title: Faint hope (1)
videos.overview: An international male top model is back in Denmark to close an important show during the fashion week, but shortly after his arrival, the party ends abruptly. His dead body is found on the beach, and since he had been a popular gentleman in the hours leading up to his death, the police struggle to figure out who last saw the young man alive.

videos.title: Faint hope (2)
videos.overview: Dan and Flemming make no progress in the case after questioning the model colleague Thomas. But, fortunately, it turns out the video equipment he stole contains important backstage recordings, which enlighten them about the deceased's last hours. Meanwhile, Dan's effort to get Josefine out of prison takes a dangerous turn.

videos.title: A battle for justice (1)
videos.overview: A female local politician has been murdered in the Thai boxing club. When Dan and Flemming arrive at the scene, they discover that the blood from the deceased forms a pattern of a butterfly, resembling the club logo. The first to be interrogated in the case are the deceased's group of friends, who train in the same club. And they are not afraid to lie to each other nor to the police.

videos.title: A battle for justice (2)
videos.overview: Roland has previously lied about his alibi, so can he be trusted when he claims that Rikke had the murder weapon on her when she met her killer? Roland is not the only one in the friend group with a motive, so Dan and co. must follow every lead, and with Benjamin on paternity leave, the others must run faster.

videos.title: A big fish in the net (1)
videos.overview: It comes as a shock to Dan Sommerdahl when he finds out who has been killed. He's hard to scare, but maybe this time he has been so consumed by the Josefine Sundby case that it ends up affecting his dearest ones? Illegal methods previously used in the investigation begin to have consequences.

videos.title: A big fish in the net (2)
videos.overview: The situation has now become so serious that forces from all over Zealand have been called in. Dan and Flemming's relationship is under such great pressure that Flemming wants to take the matter into his own hands. But if they are to solve the murder mystery, they need to cooperate. Whether the duo Astrid and Arne can lead them to the killer remains to be seen.

videos.title: SoMe (1)
videos.overview: The Tour de Zealand week is launched with a party on the harbour of Helsingør, but the joy is replaced by chok, when an influencer is found dead in the water.

videos.title: SoMe (2)
videos.overview: Even though the evidence points towards an old acquaintance, Dan and Flemming keep digging in the victims family business while the search for her son is intensified.

videos.title: The other side of the coin (1)
videos.overview: Shortly after the announcement of Miss Sunshine the winner involuntarily falls to her death. Dan and the team get busy, finding out who are fans and who are enemies.

videos.title: The other side of the coin (2)
videos.overview: The search for the father of the deceased's child continues. Meanwhile it becomes increasingly difficult for Dan to hide the truth about the hidden children from his family and friends.

videos.title: Artificial (1)
videos.overview: An artist makes a dramatic entrance at his own exhibition opening, when he falls down dead. Dan must enter the dark corners of the art world, and things are taking a dangerous turn.

videos.title: Artificial (2)
videos.overview: With his life at stake Dan catches the unexpected art thieves and the police is led in a new direction. Meanwhile Josefine is celebrated with a festive bachelor party.

videos.title: Broken promises (1)
videos.overview: The discovery of a cure against cancer sounds like a dream. But the dream turns to nightmare, when the scientist behind the discovery is found dead in his lab.

videos.title: Broken promises (2)
videos.overview: Dan and Flemming are clueless when the diseased's disappeared mother turns up and adds new life to the investigation. At the same time it has finally become time for the wedding.
